people.name: Quint Davis
people.extract: Quint Davis is an American festival producer and director based in New Orleans. He is best known as the producer of the New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival founded by George Wein. Davis has been involved in the production of the event since its start in 1970. He is the CEO of Festival Productions, Inc. - New Orleans, the company that produces the Jazz Fest.
highlights: American festival producer and director based in New Orleans.
Producer of the New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival.
Involved in Jazz Fest production since its start in 1970.
